name: claude-tools
description: Small, sharp add-ons for Claude Code: a live progress bar, multi-account switching with live limits, a status for every session, and sidebar folders with your own names.

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: A progress bar above the prompt for Claude's checklist: how many steps are done and which one is running.

plugins.name: account-status
plugins.description: Part of multi-account: reports each chat's account, 5-hour and weekly limits, context and current work; /accounts shows them all.

plugins.name: session-status
plugins.description: Shows which sessions are working, need you, or are done: a marker in the desktop app's sidebar title and a /sessions board. No alerts.

plugins.name: sidebar-folders
plugins.description: Folders with your own names in the desktop app's sidebar: new chats file themselves by project or title, chats Claude starts follow their parent, and /folder moves a chat by hand.
